verdict.rationale: TeamViewer is a remote-access and IT-management SaaS platform, so an official MCP server is a reasonable thing to ask about and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence mentions an MCP server. The Web API is only a developer building block, and the Tia AI agent is an in-product assistant rather than an MCP endpoint, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
